label: never_closed
meaning: never commanded the gripper to close

label: closed_away
meaning: first close was > 0.12 m from the target bowl; it never lifted

label: stuck_holding
meaning: closed on the bowl, never lifted it, arm stopped moving

label: missed_grasp
meaning: closed next to the target bowl, but it never lifted

label: dropped
meaning: lifted the bowl, which ended > 0.10 m from the plate

label: released_near_plate
meaning: carried the bowl to the plate and let go; the task did not count it

label: never_released
meaning: carried the bowl to the plate, still holding it at the time limit
